result.stdout:
usage: qb2vb [options] input.bas
converts a QBasic program to VB that uses QB.Compatibility

options:
  -o, --output FILE   the VB file to write (default: the input name with .vb)
      --project       also write a .vbproj that references the QB.Compatibility NuGet packages (QB.Compatibility.Sdl only if the program draws or reads the joystick; QB.Compatibility.Ports only if it opens a serial port)
      --repo DIR      like --project, but references the projects of a QB.Compatibility checkout in DIR instead of the packages
      --aot           with --project or --repo: publish as a Native AOT program
      --empty-loop-us N   start the program with QB.Core.EmptyLoopMicroseconds = N (the time of one pass of a delay loop; 400 by default)
  -V, --version       show the version
  -h, --help          show this help
  --                  end of options (the next argument is the input file)

Options that take a value accept --name value or --name=value.
